FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How do you say 'The rug is in front of the sofa.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il y a un canapé dans le salon.
   B. Le tapis est devant le canapé.
   C. C'est une table.
   D. Dans la cuisine, il y a un frigo.

2. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'tea'? (1 mark)
   A. the
   B. thè
   C. té
   D. thé

3. How do you say 'the knee' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la main
   B. les cheveux
   C. le genou
   D. l'épaule

4. Read: Amina: Bonjour, Kamau ! Bon anniversaire ! Kamau: Merci, Amina ! Amina: Tu as quel âge ? Kamau: J'ai dix ans. Amina: Voici un cadeau ! Question: What does Amina give Kamau? (1 mark)
   A. a cake
   B. a present
   C. a balloon
   D. a song

5. How do you say 'This is my sister.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Ma mère s'appelle Grace.
   B. C'est ma mère.
   C. Qui est-ce ?
   D. C'est ma sœur.

6. Read: Voici Amina. Elle a dix ans. Elle est grande. Elle a les cheveux noirs et longs. Elle a deux grands yeux. Question: How many eyes does Amina have? (1 mark)
   A. four
   B. three
   C. two
   D. one

7. How do you say the month 'January' in French? (1 mark)
   A. janvier
   B. avril
   C. juillet
   D. février

8. Which little word goes with 'lait' (the milk)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. les
   C. la
   D. l'

9. What does 'le pied' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the foot
   B. the hair
   C. the ear
   D. the eyes

10. How do you say 'bread' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le pain
   B. les frites
   C. le maïs
   D. la carotte

11. Fill in: J'ai ______ bouche. (1) (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. une
   C. deux
   D. un

12. How do we write days of the week inside a French sentence? (1 mark)
   A. with an accent
   B. all in capitals
   C. with a capital letter
   D. with a small letter

13. Fill in: C'est ______ lit. (1 mark)
   A. un
   B. la
   C. une
   D. des

14. How do you say 'near' in French? (1 mark)
   A. à gauche
   B. à droite
   C. près de
   D. tout droit

15. What does 'le livre' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the living room
   B. the table
   C. the book
   D. the cat

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Translate into English: 'Une semaine, sept jours.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

17. Translate into French: 'Go straight ahead.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

18. Translate into French: 'Tomorrow it is Thursday.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

19. Translate into English: 'Elle a les cheveux longs.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

20. Translate into French: 'Here is my grandmother.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

21. Translate into English: 'Il a les cheveux courts.' (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Le tapis est devant le canapé.
   The rug is in front of the sofa. in French is Le tapis est devant le canapé.

2. D — thé
   The correct spelling is thé, with its accents.

3. C — le genou
   the knee in French is le genou.

4. B — a present
   Un cadeau is a present.

5. D — C'est ma sœur.
   This is my sister. in French is C'est ma sœur.

6. C — two
   Deux grands yeux.

7. A — janvier
   January in French is janvier.

8. A — le
   lait is masculine, so we say le lait.

9. A — the foot
   le pied means the foot.

10. A — le pain
   bread in French is le pain.

11. B — une
   Bouche is feminine, so une bouche.

12. D — with a small letter
   French days are written with a small letter unless they start a sentence.

13. A — un
   Lit is masculine, so un.

14. C — près de
   near in French is près de.

15. C — the book
   le livre means the book.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: A week, seven days.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: Allez tout droit.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 2 marks in total.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: Demain, c'est jeudi.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 2 marks in total.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: She has long hair.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Voici ma grand-mère.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 2 marks in total.

21. (3 marks)
   Answer: He has short hair.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.
